body: A widget must have at least one of [init, render]. What if we extract this part and use `AtLeastOne` type util?

I thought about that, but in practice that would make the type more complicated for few gain, since $$type is required now, and it doesn't really make the usage simpler (will still need to use `init?.()`, since you can't know which one of the two is actually implemented). Instead I think we should in a major version make render required both here and in addWidgets;
shouldn't we use the Expand helper here?
why not use WidgetDescription directly here?
there's no conditionals, so intellisense automatically expanded the type already :)
because the actual value of the description is needed, so it needs to be a generic :)
